$comment: Rendering budget for site-perf.cjs (1900x1900 CSS px at 1.5x, dark theme, accessibility on; CPU figures include the small cost of tracing and the layer tree). Limits are the measured cost after the October 2026 performance pass plus headroom for slower CI machines. The widgets and idle-widgets layer limits (110) allow the code panes' horizontal scrolling: each wide pane is a composited scroller, which an A/B run measured at 97 layers against 54 with wrapped lines and found no difference in renderer, GPU or browser CPU, frame times or long frames. Their headroom is smaller than elsewhere because a layer count does not depend on the machine's speed; the other pages keep the default limit with scrolling code. Layer limits and the browser-process CPU of frame swaps catch the regressions that made the site heavy: composited-layer explosions and a terminal frame exposed cell by cell to assistive technology.
